name: Capacitors
pages: $(thing)Machines$() require a $(item)capacitor$() to operate. $(br2)Capacitors control the speed of the machine and store energy as μI. Better capacitors will increase a machine's speed and energy capacity. $(br2)To install a capacitor, right-click on a machine with the capacitor in your hand.

pages.text: A primitive capacitor can be made by combining certain conductive metals with $(item)Grains of Infinity$()

pages: Once you develop more advanced alloys, they can be used to improve your capacitor design.
